extracted.intended_audience: prospective grant applicants and stakeholders interested in John Templeton Foundation funding
extracted.subtask_description: Information about the Templeton Foundation's 2022 funding-cycle intake, screening outcomes, and the high-level criteria used to evaluate initial requests and invite full proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alignment with Foundation Funding Areas and philanthropic vision
rubrics_metrics.description: About 30 percent of the requests failed to pass an initial screening because they were not aligned with any of the Foundation’s Funding Areas or Sir John Templeton’s broader philanthropic vision.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Initial screening explicitly rejects proposals not aligned with the Foundation’s stated Funding Areas or overall philanthropic vision. Alignment is a threshold eligibility/fit criterion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluation based on Foundation goals, potential impact, and availability of funds
rubrics_metrics.description: Foundation staff ... evaluating its promise in light of our goals, potential impact, and the availability of funds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers assess each request for how well it advances the Foundation's goals, the expected impact of the proposed work, and whether funding resources are available — all inform decisions to invite full proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Thorough review of each request
rubrics_metrics.description: The Foundation staff places great importance on reviewing each request thoroughly ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Despite high volume, staff aim to review each initial request carefully rather than using purely automated triage; thoroughness is a stated procedural standard.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invitation rate to submit full proposals (selection statistic)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Foundation will issue invitations to submit a full proposal to 5.7 percent of the applicants who did pass the initial screening.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This gives applicants an approximate expectation of likelihood to be invited after passing initial screening; the page also reports overall counts (2,934 requests total; 2,672 + 262 SYRI).

rubrics_metrics.name: No individualized feedback for declined requests due to volume
rubrics_metrics.description: Regretfully, due to the number of inquiries, we cannot provide each applicant with specific feedback about declined requests.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should not expect detailed rejection feedback from this cycle; plan submissions knowing feedback may not be available when many inquiries are received.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow the Apply for a Grant page for process and key dates
rubrics_metrics.description: To learn more about the Foundation’s grantmaking process, including key dates, please visit our Apply for a Grant page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should consult the Foundation’s official application guidance for full procedural requirements, deadlines, and detailed instructions (not provided in this announcement).
